name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-expert-finder
title: Expert Finder
shortDescription: Find colleagues by skill, check availability, book Teams meetings and review Copilot-generated agendas before saving them to the existing invitation.
longDescription: An SPFx 1.24.1 Copilot UX component that renders an expert directory inline and in fullscreen using React, Fluent UI v9 and a SharePoint Experts list.

Explore local filters, delegated Graph photos and free/busy availability for today or the next working day, confirmed Teams meetings, introduction drafts and editable Copilot-generated agendas saved to the existing invitation.

Learn component-to-Copilot context publishing: Introduce me awaits updateModelContextAsync with a minimal selected-profile snapshot, then uses sendFollowUpMessageAsync to request a draft in the existing conversation.

A missing Experts list selects bundled fictional profiles with local portraits. Mock profiles make no Graph calls. Meeting creation and agenda saving require explicit user actions; agenda generation alone does not update the calendar.

thumbnails.alt: Expert Finder architecture: Copilot invokes a typed SPFx tool that renders a React directory using SharePoint or fictional profiles, with optional Graph actions and introduction drafting.
